decision: Do not promote the published Quick Cogeser Energia AC tariff to all IT*CGS EVSE. Cogeser first-party material now proves that the operator's own public network is no longer AC-only: a Cogeser station inaugurated in Inzago on 2025-11-25 contains one DC 25 kW charger plus AC 22 kW connectors. The current tariff page publishes 0.67 EUR/kWh specifically for 'Quick Cogeser Energia' in AC and separately publishes non-Cogeser roaming AC/DC prices; it does not publish a direct/spot DC price for Cogeser-owned DC. Therefore current IT*CGS inventory requires EVSE/station-level classification before rankability.

publishedDirectEvidence.scope: Cogeser network with bill debit for eligible customers
publishedDirectEvidence.eligibility: customers with charging debit on Cogeser electricity bill

positiveEvidence: Current Cogeser public-charging tariff page states Quick Cogeser Energia AC = 0.67 EUR/kWh VAT included from 2025-10-01.
Same page states 0.49 EUR/kWh on the Cogeser network for eligible customers using electricity-bill debit; this is conditional and must not be used as anonymous spot/ad-hoc price.

Cogeser first-party news dated 2025-11-25 documents an owned/realized Inzago station with a Circontrol Rapid 25 kW DC charger and a Circontrol eVolve 22 kW AC charger, proving the present network contains DC as well as AC.
Cogeser documents QR-code spot charging, so a station-level direct/ad-hoc surface exists in principle.
negativePaths: Do not infer Cogeser-owned DC direct price from the published 0.89 EUR/kWh non-Cogeser roaming DC tariff.
Do not apply 0.67 EUR/kWh to DC EVSE; official wording scopes it to Quick Cogeser Energia AC.
Do not apply conditional 0.49 EUR/kWh bill-debit price to anonymous/direct users without eligibility.

coverage.note: Conservative until the current 60 IT*CGS EVSE are deterministically split by AC/DC and direct channel. AC subset can then be promoted at 0.67 EUR/kWh where Quick Cogeser identity is proven; DC subset remains fail-closed until its direct price is recovered.

blockingCondition: Map current IT*CGS EVSE to Cogeser station/connectors and split AC Quick versus DC. Promote only deterministically identified Quick Cogeser AC at 0.67 EUR/kWh. For Cogeser-owned DC, obtain QR/direct-payment/backend or first-party station tariff before rankability.

set.blockingCondition: split current IT*CGS EVSE AC/DC; 0.67 EUR/kWh applies only to proven Quick Cogeser AC; recover direct Cogeser DC tariff separately

history: 2026-09-22: first-party 2025-11-25 Inzago evidence proves current Cogeser network includes DC; class-wide AC assumption invalidated and CGS moved to station-level fail-closed pending deterministic EVSE split.
